about: Claude's own hand review (2026-10-22) of alerts in data/complyai.db as of the second IT batch (530 alerts; finding ids). To compare with the LEONI reviewer's answers in ComplyAI_alert_review_2026-10-22.xlsx (sheet Review, column 'Alert ID'). C = right IT + plausible real gap, W = right IT but the IT already covers it, R = nearby topic, another IT governs it, U = unrelated IT. 'new_its' = 45 random alerts against the new ITs; the 40 alerts of the 7-IT database are not in this database any more. The finding ids refer to the database before the magnet filter (2026-10-24/25), kept as data/snapshots/real_before_magnet_filter.db; ComplyAI_alert_review_2026-10-22.xlsx matches that database, ComplyAI_alert_review_2026-10-25.xlsx the current one.
